```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(httr)
library(ggdark)
library(sf)
library(tmap)
library(tigris)
library(tidycensus)
source('Functions.r')
```

#Load in Henry County SF Files
```{r}
regions <- st_read('../../../Henry County GIS Data/Georgia Smart Communities/Regions_Smoothed.shp') %>%
  mutate('Region Name' = paste0('Region ', RegionID))

hc_border <- counties(state = 'GA', progress_bar = FALSE) %>%
  filter(NAME == 'Henry') %>%
  select(geometry)

roads <- st_read('../../../Henry County GIS Data/Georgia Smart Communities/Roads.shp')

vars <- load_variables(year = 2021, dataset = 'acs5')
acs_zip <- get_acs(geography = 'zcta', variables = c('B01003_001', 'B03002_001'), key = 'cf3c51073f5e6be8f75b96e5c12662a25525326b', geometry = TRUE, output = 'wide')
acs_place <- get_acs(geography = 'place', state = 'GA', variables = c('Total_Population' = 'B01003_001','Total Latino' = 'B03001_003'), key = 'cf3c51073f5e6be8f75b96e5c12662a25525326b', geometry = TRUE, output = 'wide')
```
